pkgmetadata.longdescription: With --accept-routes, Tailscale on Linux routes traffic to a LAN through a subnet router even when the machine is on that LAN itself. LAN hosts then see the subnet router as the source (NAT) and cannot connect back, which breaks e.g. KDE Connect file transfers. This package adds a policy routing rule just before Tailscale's rules so that directly connected networks win, while Tailscale's routes still apply away from that LAN.
